label: CSV to JSONL
description: Prepare batch-ready JSON Lines from a CSV file, preserving leading-zero identifiers and text fields.
useCase: Prepare batch-ready JSON Lines from a CSV file, preserving leading-zero identifiers and text fields.
outputNotes: One compact JSON object is exported per source row, with a final newline.
caveat: Headers must be unique and nonempty; tabular values are not automatically inferred as numbers.

label: CSV to JSON
description: Convert CSV records into a JSON object array for scripts, APIs and local test fixtures.
useCase: Convert CSV records into a JSON object array for scripts, APIs and local test fixtures.
outputNotes: A formatted JSON array contains one object for each CSV data row.
caveat: Malformed row widths are rejected and all values remain JSON strings.

label: CSV to TSV
description: Transfer comma-separated values into tab-aware tools without retyping a source table.
useCase: Transfer comma-separated values into tab-aware tools without retyping a source table.
outputNotes: The output uses tab delimiters and quotes fields containing separators or line breaks.
caveat: This conversion does not validate or infer data types; review formulas before spreadsheet import.

label: CSV to Markdown Table
description: Place a small CSV dataset into README files, Markdown reports or technical notes.
useCase: Place a small CSV dataset into README files, Markdown reports or technical notes.
outputNotes: The result is a pipe-separated Markdown table with a header divider.
caveat: Embedded newlines are flattened and wide cells may require manual presentation edits.

label: CSV to HTML Table
description: Create a static, escaped HTML table fragment from a CSV dataset for documentation.
useCase: Create a static, escaped HTML table fragment from a CSV dataset for documentation.
outputNotes: Output includes table headers and body rows with HTML-escaped data cells.
caveat: No responsive stylesheet, pagination or full HTML document is produced.

label: CSV to SQL INSERT
description: Prepare SQL INSERT statements for reviewed imports into an existing records table.
useCase: Prepare SQL INSERT statements for reviewed imports into an existing records table.
outputNotes: Each data row becomes one INSERT INTO records statement with escaped string literals.
caveat: This provides neither type inference nor CREATE TABLE commands; inspect SQL before execution.

label: CSV to Excel-friendly UTF-8
description: Save a UTF-8 CSV with BOM for spreadsheet import and formula escaping in every row.
useCase: Save a UTF-8 CSV with BOM for spreadsheet import and formula escaping in every row.
outputNotes: Output begins with a UTF-8 BOM and uses CRLF row endings, escaping header and data formulas.
caveat: Excel can still coerce long numeric identifiers and dates; import sensitive columns as text.

label: Remove Duplicate CSV Rows
description: Remove exactly repeated CSV rows while preserving the first occurrence and original order.
useCase: Remove exactly repeated CSV rows while preserving the first occurrence and original order.
outputNotes: A CSV file is exported with the header and only the first instance of each distinct data row.
caveat: Case and whitespace differences remain distinct; this is not keyed or semantic deduplication.

label: Sort CSV Rows by First Column
description: Reorder CSV data rows by the first column for quick comparison of similar exports.
useCase: Reorder CSV data rows by the first column for quick comparison of similar exports.
outputNotes: The header remains in place while first-column values determine data-row ordering.
caveat: This is lexical string sorting, not date, numeric or multi-key ordering.

label: Remove Empty CSV Rows
description: Discard CSV records where every column is blank or whitespace, leaving populated rows untouched.
useCase: Discard CSV records where every column is blank or whitespace, leaving populated rows untouched.
outputNotes: Only entirely blank data rows are removed; all other records remain in a CSV export.
caveat: The converter does not trim individual cells or delete partially blank records.

label: TSV to CSV
description: Turn tab-separated data into comma-delimited text accepted by CSV processing tools.
useCase: Turn tab-separated data into comma-delimited text accepted by CSV processing tools.
outputNotes: Tab-delimited records are converted to correctly quoted comma-separated rows.
caveat: Inconsistent column counts fail rather than being padded or silently repaired.

label: TSV to JSON
description: Create a JSON object array from TSV headings and tab-separated data records.
useCase: Create a JSON object array from TSV headings and tab-separated data records.
outputNotes: The first row supplies JSON object keys and each value remains a string.
caveat: Unique nonempty headers are required and missing-value types cannot be inferred.

label: TSV to JSONL
description: Prepare newline-delimited JSON objects from TSV rows for batch-processing workflows.
useCase: Prepare newline-delimited JSON objects from TSV rows for batch-processing workflows.
outputNotes: One serialized JSON object is written per TSV record, with a trailing newline.
caveat: The source must have a consistent number of columns and unique headings.

label: TSV to Markdown Table
description: Render TSV records as a Markdown pipe table for notes and repository documentation.
useCase: Render TSV records as a Markdown pipe table for notes and repository documentation.
outputNotes: Table headings, a separator row and escaped pipe characters are emitted.
caveat: Multiline field content is flattened and very wide tables may not render comfortably.

label: TSV to HTML Table
description: Publish an escaped HTML table fragment generated from tab-separated records.
useCase: Publish an escaped HTML table fragment generated from tab-separated records.
outputNotes: The fragment includes HTML table headings and escaped body cell values.
caveat: This is static table markup, not a complete website or interactive grid.
